title: CIA's Scientific Engineering Institute farm lab near Boston
summary: Jesse Michels tells of CIA's Scientific Engineering Institute farm lab near Boston, about 1960s-1970s at Near Boston, Massachusetts, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: To support this work, members of the OAD created the Scientific Engineering Institute, a CIA proprietary organization near Boston, which included a rural lab on a several hundred acre farm.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in the 1960s and 70s members of a CIA research office set up the Scientific Engineering Institute, a private-looking company secretly owned by the CIA, near Boston. According to Michels, it included a country lab on a farm of several hundred acres. He tells it to show how the agency hid unusual research behind ordinary-seeming fronts.
